provenance.reference_distribution: DeepNeo-CL SupCon 5-fold ensemble scores on the FULL TransPHLA independent benchmark (n=161,652, 112 HLA-I alleles, ~50:50 balanced)
provenance.limitations: Proxy: this is the benchmark-corpus score distribution, not the training-corpus one. A v2 full-training-corpus CDF (score each fold's held-out training partition; union) is queued but requires a 2+ h GPU rescoring pass. If the v1 vs batch-rank AUROC delta reported below is small (< 0.001), the manuscript's fusion numbers are safe under either definition.
